assessment.reason: Modest main-line case merits consideration, not a validated edge; defensive absences weaken it.
assessment.model_case: Four games average 4.5 catches on seven targets; projected targets fall to 5.77. That opportunity reduction—not the modest defensive adjustment—drives the 3.68 projection. Calibration substantially lowers the raw under estimate; market/tail validation counts are unavailable.
assessment.price_case: Main line matches all five books. -105 is better than the other four under quotes; supplied calibrated and blended estimates exceed break-even, narrowly for the blend. Consensus includes this offer, not independent confirmation.
assessment.context_case: Reported absences could improve catch efficiency but reduce Dallas passing volume through game script. Their incorporation is unknown; line availability remains unresolved.
